name: Operations — Project Sprint (2 Weeks)
description: A two-week project sprint template with planning, daily standups, mid-sprint review, and retrospective. Based on agile/sprint methodology. Suitable for software teams, project groups, or any team running time-boxed delivery cycles.

events.title: Day 1 — Sprint Planning
events.description: Review backlog, agree on sprint goal, estimate and commit to sprint items.

events.title: Day 1 — Task Breakdown
events.description: Break sprint items into tasks. Assign initial owners.

events.title: Day 2 — Daily Standup
events.description: What did you do? What will you do? Any blockers?

events.title: Day 3 — Daily Standup
events.description: Daily sync. Track progress against sprint goal.

events.title: Day 5 — Mid-Sprint Review
events.description: Review progress at week 1 end. Adjust scope if needed. Demo early work.

events.title: Day 6 — Daily Standup
events.description: Week 2 start. Refocus on remaining sprint items.

events.title: Day 8 — Daily Standup
events.description: Daily sync. Focus on closing items.

events.title: Day 9 — Final Push & Testing
events.description: Complete remaining tasks. Final testing and quality checks.

events.title: Day 10 — Sprint Review / Demo
events.description: Demonstrate completed work to product owner and stakeholders.

events.title: Day 10 — Sprint Retrospective
events.description: What went well? What didn't? What to improve? Action items for next sprint.

events.title: Sprint Closed
events.description: Sprint formally concluded. Unfinished items return to backlog.
